6453.title: Codex session catalogs diverge from model discovery
6453.rootCauseOneLine: Fresh session catalogs stay session-local while discovery reuses a separate persistent app-server and the picker reads only the server catalog store.
6453.proposedFix: Publish route-scoped validated session catalogs to the existing server catalog store and define discovery-process freshness; preserve routing, metadata, and newer-result ordering.
6453.caveats: Hermetic bridge/session regression repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout; no live Windows UI or external rollout tested. No PR because a complete repair crosses subsystem/shared-contract boundaries.
